correctness.rationale: A fresh independent replay using the package's line-major Fano edge indexing enumerated all 3,461 nonempty matchings with face vector 21,168,644,1218,1050,336,24. Rebuilding the documented toggle order gives exactly 1,722 matched covers and leaves one critical vertex and sixteen critical four-simplices. The orientation of all 14,574 nonempty-face-poset Hasse covers topologically sorts completely, so the matching is acyclic. Forman theory therefore gives one zero-cell and sixteen four-cells with no intermediate cells, hence the claimed wedge. This independently verifies the certificate rather than relying on its printed VERIFY_OK line.
